page_title: LEC 1-1 JUV | Lecce v Juventus 01/12/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+3' 1 - 1 Goal! Nikola Krstovic plays a pass to the feet of Ante Rebic (Lecce), and he shoots into the bottom left corner from inside the box. It's 1:1.
90+1' Samuel Mbangula (Juventus) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
89' Lassana Coulibaly (Lecce) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
86' Nicolo Fagioli (Juventus) launches into a thunderous tackle on his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
84' We are about to witness a subsitution. Santiago Pierotti (Lecce) for Antonino Gallo.
84' Thiago Motta prepares a substitution. Francisco Conceicao is replaced by Diego Pugno (Juventus).
83' A mid-range free kick is awarded to Lecce out wide and from this angle a cross into the box is likely.
82' Yellow card. Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
81' Substitution. Remi Oudin (Lecce) has come on for Hamza Rafia.
77' Hamza Rafia (Lecce) takes the corner.
75' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Ante Rebic (Lecce) comes onto the pitch so that Tete Morente can be given a rest.
75' Marco Giampaolo decides to make a substitution. Ylber Ramadani will be replaced by Mohamed Kaba (Lecce).
75' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Kenan Yildiz departs the field of play to be replaced by Samuel Mbangula (Juventus).
73' Nicolo Fagioli (Juventus) is awarded a yellow card for his behaviour.

68' 0 - 1 Goal! Teun Koopmeiners passes the ball to Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) and he fires in a shot from the edge of the box which is deflected. Wladimiro Falcone couldn't do anything about it. 0:1.
67' The whistle is blown for an infringement and Danilo (Juventus) receives a yellow card!
65' Neat passing move from Juventus in order to create new attacking opportunities.
65' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
63' Thiago Motta has decided to make a change. Nicolo Fagioli (Juventus) replaces Khephren Thuram.
63' The manager makes a subsitution with Jonas Rouhi (Juventus) coming on for Federico Gatti.
62' A sweet pass inside the box gives Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) time to measure a shot, but it's slightly mishit and goes just wide of the right post. That really was a great chance!
61' Federico Gatti (Juventus) latches on to an accurate pass into the box and immediately unleashes a low shot goalwards. His effort is well saved by the keeper.
60' Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.

57' Patrick Dorgu (Lecce) bursts into the box after a fine solo run. He looks up and tries to place a shot into the bottom right corner, but Mattia Perin makes a great save to deny him his moment of glory.
55' Tete Morente (Lecce) picks up a rebound inside the penalty area and drills a shot to the middle of the goal, but is denied by a reflex save from Mattia Perin.
53' A corner kick by Juventus is thwarted by the well prepared Wladimiro Falcone (Lecce).
53' Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
51' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
50' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) jumps inside the box to meet the corner and aims a low header towards middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper shows his reflexes to stop the effort.
49' The linesman points to the corner flag, Lecce are going to take it.
47' Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
46' The second half has just started.
45+2' Antonio Rapuano has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
39' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) gets booked for the first time in this match.
39' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
38' Surely that's handball by one of the Lecce players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
33' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Wladimiro Falcone intercepts the ball.
30' The ball possession at the moment is 35:65.
26' The Juventus players’ celebrations are quickly cut short after referee Antonio Rapuano signals NO GOAL following the VAR review due to an offside.
25' The goal for Juventus is subject to a VAR review by the referee! He's obviously unsure or he received a message.
25' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Timothy Weah (Juventus) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
22' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) sends a long cross over to Teun Koopmeiners, but Wladimiro Falcone comes forward to gather the ball.
21' Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) will take a corner kick.
19' Lassana Coulibaly (Lecce) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
16' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) creates a good chance for himself and goes for goal from mid-range, but he fails to change the score as his effort deflects away off the left post.
14' Patrick Dorgu (Lecce) will take the free kick.
13' The Juventus players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
8' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lecce.

6' Khephren Thuram (Juventus) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his strike from the penalty spot wasn't accurate enough and the ball bounced away off the left post!
5' Khephren Thuram (Juventus) and Kenan Yildiz matched up again to find some space for an unmarked teammate.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out at last! Juventus will take the kick-off.
Antonio Rapuano was nominated as the referee for this game.
